items.reason: A low-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for softening the look of fine lines.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 should go with it.
Your scan shows low moisture, and a light ceramide moisturizer helps skin feel comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.

response.routine_note: Start the retinol 2 nights a week after cleansing, then follow with moisturizer, and build up slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the SPF every morning and reapply it when you are outdoors.
